The *Mahāpesakārapetivatthu* (Pv 9), translated as "Master Weaver", is a canonical story in the *Petavatthu* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The narrative examines the karmic retribution that arises from insulting those who perform acts of generosity, addressing what happens when one scorns or reviles those who give alms [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records four translations of the text in four different languages [SuttaCentral].
